definition: Serial F means every world w has at least one successor v with F.access w v. It says nothing about reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity or connections between components. A non-reflexive world can occur in D, although full-predicate MC at that world is impossible.
note: Stipulated mathematical semantics for issue #263, not a historical source attribution or an assertion of metaphysical possibility. A philosophical adoption would require its own pinned source reading.
